coaching_qa.query: How should I position my elbows and wrists on JM presses to maximize triceps tension safely?
coaching_qa.generated_output: Keep elbows tucked at roughly 45 degrees to the torso to isolate the long head and protect the shoulder joint. Maintain a neutral wrist position—avoid hyperextension or excessive flexion—to ensure force transfers directly through the triceps without joint shear. Control the eccentric phase actively; do not let momentum drive the bar down. If you feel pinching in the shoulder or sharp wrist pain, stop immediately and reassess your grip width or elbow angle.
